result.topic_en: Formula-only scratch calculations: a solid-angle integral with $\operatorname{tg}\psi = r/x$, an integral of $f(x)/\sqrt{(z-x)(z'-x)}$, and ellipsoid potential-type integrals $\int_\sigma^\infty \frac{ds}{\Delta}(1-\frac{x^2}{s+a^2}-\dots)$, with substitutions involving $\operatorname{tg}\varphi$, $\psi$, $\psi'$ and complex square roots.
result.transcription:
[sketch of a cone/angle with $x$, $\psi$]
$\operatorname{tg}\psi = \frac{r}{x}$
$\frac{x}{\sqrt{r^2+x^2}}$
$\int_0^{2\pi} \sin\psi\, \partial\psi$ $\quad -\cos\psi$
$2\pi \quad 1-\cos\psi$
$1-\frac{x}{\sqrt{r^2+x^2}}$
[-$\frac{rr+xx}{xx} - \dots$-]
[-$\frac{rr+xx}{xx}$-]$-1$ $\qquad 1-\frac{xx}{rr+}$[?]
$1-\frac{x}{\sqrt{r^2+xx}}\;(rr+xx)$
$rr+xx$ [-$=$-] $x\sqrt{rr+xx}$
$\left([-\dots-]\, 1-[-\dots-]\frac{x}{\sqrt{1+xx}}\right)(1+xx)$
$\partial t$
$\int_0$ [-$f(x)(z-x)(z'-x)$-] $\partial x$ $\qquad \int_z^{z'} \frac{f(x)\,\partial x}{\sqrt{(z-x)(z'-x)}}$
$\int_\sigma^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}$ [-$\dots$-] $\left(1-\frac{x^2}{s+a^2}-\frac{y^2}{s+b^2}-\frac{z^2}{s+c^2}\right)$
$\int_\sigma^\infty \frac{\partial s}{\Delta}\left(1-\frac{r^2}{s+a^2}-\frac{x^2}{s+c^2}\right)$ $\qquad a^2-\frac{r^2}{(t+1)}[?]-\frac{x^2}{t+\frac{c^2}{a^2}}[?]=0$
$\sqrt{(1+\frac{s}{a^2})^2(1+\frac{s}{c^2})}$ $\quad s=a^2t$ $\qquad a^2 = r^2\cos\varphi^2 + x^2\cot\varphi^2$
$\int^\infty \frac{\partial t}{(1+s)\sqrt{1+\frac{a^2s}{c^2}}}\left(a^2-\frac{r^2}{s+1}-\frac{x^2}{s+\frac{c^2}{a^2}}\right)$ $\qquad \varphi$ $\qquad \frac{1}{\sin\varphi^2}$[?] $\qquad \frac{x}{r-a}=\operatorname{tg}\psi$
$a^2(\operatorname{tg}\varphi^2+1) = r^2+x^2(\cot\varphi^2+1)$ $\qquad \frac{x}{r+a}=\operatorname{tg}\psi'$
$2a\int_\tau^\infty \frac{\partial s}{1+s\Delta s}$ $\qquad \frac{a^2}{\operatorname{tg}}[?]\operatorname{tg}\varphi^2 - x^2\cot\varphi^2 = \frac{r^2+x^2-a^2}{ax}$ $\qquad$ [-$\dots$-] $\frac{x}{r-a}$
$\log\frac{1+\sqrt{s}\,i}{1-\sqrt{s}\,i}$
$s=\operatorname{tg}\varphi$ $\qquad \sqrt{r^2+x^2-a^2-2axi}$
$\sqrt{(r-a+xi)(r+a-xi)} + \sqrt{(r-a-xi)(r+a-xi)}$
$\cos i$ $\qquad \cos(\psi+\psi')$
$a\operatorname{tg}\varphi + x\cot\varphi\, i$ $\qquad \cot\varphi^2 = \frac{a^2}{x^2}$
$\frac{x}{a}$[-$\dots$-]$\varphi^2 = \operatorname{tg}\frac{(\psi+\psi')}{2}$
$\cot\varphi^2 = \quad \frac{1}{r+a}$

methods.what: Solid angle of a cone via integral of sin psi
Substitution s = a^2 t to normalise integral
Logarithmic form of integral via s = tan phi
Relation defining phi from r, x, a
Angles psi, psi' defined by tangents and half-sum relation
